entries.what: 2020 Census blocks (residents and housing units, for building weights)
entries.note: 2020 Census block counts (P.L. 94-171). Each residential footprint is weighted by its block's 2020 residents, shared by footprint area; 15,239 homes built since 2020 (main footprints beyond the block's 2020 housing units) are credited at their block group's residents per unit.

187,929 footprints typed RESIDENTIAL plus 14,222 untyped footprints lying in a residential land-use designation, before the size filter. City footprint layer, last edited July 2026; land use is the Metropolitan Bakersfield General Plan layer.

entries.what: NAIP 2022 aerial imagery (tree-cover model outside the USFS map)
entries.publisher: USDA Farm Service Agency, via Microsoft Planetary Computer
entries.note: Flown 2022-06-07 to 2022-06-08. Per-pixel model trained on the USFS map; on held-out cells against the USFS figure: urban cells (n=300) bias -0.12 points, mean absolute error 0.92, rank correlation 0.963; open-land cells (n=101) bias -0.01, mean absolute error 0.62. Count is cells filled.
2022 redistricting, council map 5B (Unity Map). Member names as fetched; the ward number is the stable label.
Priority Populations 5.0, in effect for projects selected on or after September 18, 2026. Areas only; low-income households qualify anywhere and are not mapped.

entries.what: Street centrelines (area names by cross streets)
entries.note: Names and road class only; used to name each area by its cross streets, not for routing or street length.

entries.publisher: Golden Empire Transit, via City of Bakersfield GIS Office
entries.note: GET Bus Stops layer, last edited June 2026.
Park and Recreation layer: active public parks (city, county, North of the River district, state). Golf courses, the fairgrounds and private parks are left out.
School Facilities layer; open schools only. The layer's own verification dates are from 2018, so a school opened since may be missing.
